newsitem.title: USA: Smith International names Kennedy CFO.
newsitem.headline: Smith International names Kennedy CFO.

text.p: Smith International Inc said Monday it had named John Kennedy as chief financial officer and senior vice president.
Kennedy joined Smith in 1986 and was appointed treasurer in 1991. In 1994, he became vice president and chief accounting officer, the company said.

Smith, a supplier of products and services to the oil and gas drilling industries, said former chief financial officer Loren Carroll will continue as director and executive vice president of the company, as well as serving as president and chief executive officer of its largest operating unit, M-I Drilling Fluids LLC.
